sources: https://cityofprattks.com/299/6th-Street-RV-Park, read 2026-11-05: 'City of Pratt RV sites are located in 6th Street Park in the north ball field parking lot. RV spots are first come, first serve and include electric and water hook-ups. Fee is $10 per night with a maximum of 7 nights. Fee can be paid at City Hall; 619 S. Main, Monday through Friday 8 am to 5 pm or in the box at the RV site. RV dump site is located approximately one block south of the sites but still in the park. Key is available at City Hall, M-F, 8 am - 5 pm or at the Law Enforcement Center; 303 S. Oak, 24/7.' Contact: Parks Department Supervisor, Phone: 620-672-6882.

Google Maps 'City of Pratt RV Site' (RV park, 818 S Pine St, Pratt, no phone or website), 4.6 from 20 reviews, read 2026-11-05: '6 months ago - Great city owned spot for RVers stopping through town. $10! They provide electricity, running water and nearby bathrooms'; 'a year ago - Easy electric, and well maintained toilets (no showers)'; '3 years ago - You have to get a key from the city offices to unlock the dump station ... Decent 30 amp electric and water hook-ups. No sewer hook up. Fairly level Back-ins only. No shade'; '2 years ago - worth the $10 a day for 30 amp and good water pressure'.
Esri World Imagery 37.63924,-98.73299 at 150 m half-width, 2026-11-05: the pin is on the open gravel lot north of the ball fields in 6th Street Park; no water nearby.

values.note: City of Pratt: $10 a night with electric and water; pay at City Hall or the box at the site.

hookups.source: https://cityofprattks.com/299/6th-Street-RV-Park ('include electric and water hook-ups') + Google reviews read 2026-11-05 ('Decent 30 amp electric and water hook-ups. No sewer hook up'; 'worth the $10 a day for 30 amp'). Amperage and no-sewer are camper reports.

facilities.source: https://cityofprattks.com/299/6th-Street-RV-Park ('RV dump site is located approximately one block south of the sites but still in the park') + Google reviews read 2026-11-05 ('well maintained toilets (no showers)'; 'nearby bathrooms'). Toilets/showers are camper reports.

note: City of Pratt RV sites in the north ball-field parking lot of 6th Street Park; back-ins with little shade; the ball fields can be busy May-July. The dump station (in the park, one block south) is locked; get the key at City Hall (619 S. Main, weekdays 8-5) or the Law Enforcement Center (303 S. Oak, 24/7). --Claude
summary: City page confirms FCFS sites with electric and water, $10/night, 7-night max, pay at City Hall or the on-site box, locked dump in the park (key from City Hall or police 24/7). Reviews: 30 A, no sewer, toilets, no showers. Fees/booking now manual; hookups and facilities reported. Google 4.6/20. Phone found. Pin fine, not waterfront.
